source: Environment and Climate Change Canada — MSC GeoMet LTCE

story.description: Lillooet, BC recorded 20.3 °C. It exceeded the previous record high maximum temperature of 19.4 °C from 1917.

highlights.text: 69 records broken, 3 tied. The most common type was record high maximum temperature (34 of 72).
15 records broken. The most common type was record high maximum temperature (8 of 15).
10 records broken. The most common type was record high minimum temperature (5 of 10).
1 record broken. It was a record high minimum temperature.
